rule_metadata.author: @neu5ron, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
rule_metadata.title: ETW Trace Evasion Activity

rules.rule_text:
title: ETW Trace Evasion Activity
id: a238b5d0-ce2d-4414-a676-7a531b3d13d6
status: test
description: 'Detects command line activity that attempts to tamper with Event Tracing
  for Windows (ETW) by clearing or disabling

  trace logs or providers. Adversaries may target ETW to blind security tooling and
  evade detection by removing

  visibility into process activity, network connections, and other telemetry sources.

  Techniques include clearing logs via wevtutil, disabling trace sessions via logman,
  and removing or modifying

  ETW providers using PowerShell cmdlets such as Remove-EtwTraceProvider and Set-EtwTraceProvider.

  '
references:
- https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/wevtutil
- https://abuse.io/lockergoga.txt
- https://medium.com/palantir/tampering-with-windows-event-tracing-background-offense-and-defense-4be7ac62ac63
author: '@neu5ron, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community'
date: 2019-03-22
modified: 2026-10-12
tags:
- attack.stealth
- attack.defense-impairment
- attack.t1070
- attack.t1685
- car.2016-04-002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_wevtutil_img:
  - Image|endswith: \wevtutil.exe
  - OriginalFileName: wevtutil.exe
  selection_wevtutil_cli_clear:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - ' cl '
    - clear-log
    CommandLine|contains|windash: /Trace
  selection_wevtutil_cli_disable:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - ' sl '
    - set-log
    CommandLine|contains|windash: /e:false
  selection_logman_img:
  - Image|endswith: \logman.exe
  - OriginalFileName: Logman.exe
  selection_logman_update:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
    - update
    - trace
    - --p
    - -ets
  selection_pwsh_img:
  - Image|endswith:
    - \powershell.exe
    - \pwsh.exe
  - OriginalFileName:
    - powershell.exe
    - pwsh.dll
  selection_pwsh_cli:
  - CommandLine|contains: Remove-EtwTraceProvider
  - CommandLine|contains|all:
    - Set-EtwTraceProvider
    - '0x11'
  - CommandLine|contains|all:
    - Set-EtwTraceProvider
    - ' 17'
  - CommandLine|contains|all:
    - Set-EtwTraceProvider
    - '''17'''
  - CommandLine|contains|all:
    - Set-EtwTraceProvider
    - '"17"'
  condition: '(selection_wevtutil_img and 1 of selection_wevtutil_cli_*)

    or (all of selection_logman_*)

    or (all of selection_pwsh_*)

    '
falsepositives:
- Unknown
level: high
